title: Text Reverser
h1: Text Reverser — Reverse Text, Words or Lines
seoTitle: Free Text Reverser — Reverse Strings, Words and Lines Online
description: Reverse any text instantly: whole string, word by word, or line by line. Useful for puzzles, coding tests and quick edits. Runs in your browser.
intro: Paste text and choose how to reverse it — character order, word order, or each line. Results update as you type.
blurb: Reverse text by characters, words or lines instantly.
howItWorks: Select reverse mode: characters, word order or line order.
The reversed result appears instantly in the output box.
examples: The quick brown fox → fox brown quick The (word order)

faq.q: Does this preserve spaces and punctuation?
faq.a: Yes. Character reverse keeps every character in reverse order. Word reverse keeps words intact and reverses their sequence.
Yes. All processing happens in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
Yes. Line-order mode reverses the sequence of lines while keeping each line's content.
